docs.purpose: Lets a user bookmark or un-bookmark a specific job or builder from within the app so it does or does not appear on their tracked list, and tells them how many other tradespeople are currently also interested in that same lead.
docs.data_story: It reads 3 tables — `lead_views`, `user_profiles` and `entitlements` and writes `lead_views`. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 1 field, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. It is called from 3 places: `mobile/src/hooks/useSaveLead.ts`, `mobile/src/hooks/useRemoveFromBoard.ts`, `overlay_search_permits_sheet`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `MUTATION`. It declares `database.writes[]` with a `write_discipline` per target (the Spec 122 vocabulary verbatim), its idempotency posture, its optimistic contract and its rollback. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: Header also cites 36_flight_center_tool.md, 91_mobile_lead_feed.md and 76_lead_feed_health_dashboard.md. All DB reads/writes are delegated to the shared src/features/leads/lib/record-lead-view.ts helper (the same one /api/leads/view uses), which upserts lead_views and separately selects a 30-day distinct-viewer count from lead_views. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: CENSUS AGREEMENT on reads (lead_views, user_profiles, entitlements) and on the lead_views write. CENSUS DISAGREEMENT: census_writes omits `user_profiles`. src/lib/auth/get-user-context.ts:84-88 executes `INSERT INTO user_profiles (user_id, trade_slug, display_name) VALUES ('dev-user','plumbing','Dev User') ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING` on every call, gated on isDevMode() && uid === 'dev-user' (get-user-context.ts:83) — so it is unreachable in production but it IS a write on this route's path. Same finding applies to /api/leads/search and /api/leads/view. Second note: the entitlements LEFT JOIN is executed for this route (get-user-context.ts:99) but the resulting subscription_status is never read by the save handler — the table is a read, not a gate. | Idempotency: Guarded. The lead_views write is an UPSERT: `ON CONFLICT (user_id, lead_key, trade_slug) DO UPDATE SET saved = EXCLUDED.saved, saved_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.saved THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END` (src/features/leads/lib/record-lead-view.ts:173-175). A repeat POST with the same body converges to the same row state; `saved_at` is refreshed to NOW() on each repeated save (not IS DISTINCT FROM-guarded), so the timestamp moves on replay while `saved` does not. lead_key is deterministic (buildLeadKey, record-lead-view.ts:77-94, revision zero-padded+truncated to 2 chars at :90). | Caching: none observed — no `export const revalidate`/`dynamic`, no Cache-Control header, no unstable_cache in src/app/api/leads/save/route.ts:1-221 (grepped src/app/api/**/{leads,notifications,onboarding}/**/route.ts for revalidate|dynamic=|unstable_cache|Cache-Control: zero matches) | Rate bucket: leads-save:<uid> (src/app/api/leads/save/route.ts:164) | Other guards / classification: Content-Type allowlist at src/app/api/leads/save/route.ts:141-148 (415). trade_slug is taken from the auth context, never the body (route.ts:181/191) — the route has no trade-membership check because there is no client-supplied trade to check. | Locking tests: src/tests/api-leads-save.infra.test.ts.
